data.name: Isaiah
data.gender_notes: Isaiah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Isaiah is recorded in name-lists as “Yahweh is salvation”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Isaiah expresses “Yahweh is salvation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isaiah total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yeshayahu: yasha, 'to save', + Yahu, 'Yahweh'. Its root is Hebrew y-sh-ʿ-y-h-w. The prophet Isaiah; the Book of Isaiah. Isaiah is a Hebrew name meaning “Yahweh is salvation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
